coordinateSystem: 488x680; references only; pAfter=center+scale*(pBefore-center)+(tx,ty), center=(244,340); pixels.normalize handles source resolution/letterboxing first
policy: One shared translation and uniform scale fitted on frozen calibration cards to the retained painter stock boundaries, equally weighted by material. The target includes the actual scaled frame and white border mask. No text, art, internal bevel, HSB, rotation, anisotropic or per-scan fitting. Held-out cards only validate the frozen transform. Residual opposed boundaries remain a source-geometry diagnostic.

guards.runtime: Require set, stock, normal layout, family, exact pinned frame URL, frame rectangle and mask URL. Byte hashes document the cached sources and need not trigger another runtime download.
